question_text: In a recent Department of Health (DOH) ruling, the legal principle of habeas corpus was invoked to question the continued detention of a patient in a mental health facility. Which of the following best defines habeas corpus?

options.text: A court order requiring a person to be brought before a judge to determine if their detention is lawful
A legal doctrine that allows the government to detain individuals without trial during a public health emergency
A writ that compels a witness to testify in a criminal proceeding
A constitutional provision guaranteeing the right to a speedy trial
